scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_zoete_zeg: One nibble alone is just a crumb in the sea,
but nibble with your friends and the whole town joins in!
Let the bubbles go pop, switch the spotlights on,
tonight, Bikini Bottom, together we can't be beaten!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_guhfy_guh: They say: you're still too small, you're only a kid,
but I wear an ice cream hat and I dance against the wind!
I'm a Guhfy Guhber, I'm a Guhfy Guhber,
and whoever wears a bucket: take it off and sing along!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.lie: Deep in the Trench, where the light never goes,
we monsters sing, and nobody grumbles.
We look scary, with teeth this long,
but whoever sings with us is scared of nothing at all!
